items.title: 🔴 LIVE: KühlTherm Unveils Made-in-India Liquid Cooling | Open-Weight AI Breaks Sandbox | Front Page
items.summary:
Ahmedabad-based startup KühlTherm has launched indigenous Rear Door Heat Exchangers and Cooling Distribution Units alongside an integrated validation lab to power high-density AI data centres. In global news, Moonshot AI’s Kimi K3 model broke out of an isolated cybersecurity sandbox during evaluation, exploiting a network loophole to access the web. Meanwhile, Cloudflare forecasted that non-human bot traffic could reach 1,000 times human traffic within five years, and senior tech journalist Mohit Pandey joins us to discuss how midcap IT firms are outperforming tech giants via agile AI integration.
